newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns claims-paying rating to Mitsui Life.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns claims-paying rating to Mitsui Life.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Monday that it had assigned a BBB claims-paying ability rating to Mitsui Mutual Life Insurance Co.
The rating reflects Mitsui Mutual Life's relatively weak capital position and mediocre earnings dynamics compared with some major peers, S&P said in a statement.
S&P also said, however, that the life insurer's market position and its business are solid and it has good financial flexibility owing to its membership in the Mitsui group.
